newsitem.title: GERMANY: Tietmeyer says dollar finding way back up.
newsitem.headline: Tietmeyer says dollar finding way back up.

text.p: Bundesbank President Hans Tietmeyer said on Tuesday that the dollar was once again on its way back up and said he always welcomed the dollar being at its correct level.
"The dollar is back on its way upward," Tietmeyer said in answer to reporters' questions. "I always welcome it when the dollar finds its correct value," he added.
The Bundesbank president was giving a speech on monetary union to a banking audience in Frankfurt.
Tietmeyer says dollar finding way back up
The dollar was trading just above the crucial 1.50-mark level at 1731 GMT, after hitting a new intraday high on the Tietmeyer comments.

Currency markets had been looking out for Tietmeyer to reinforce a message given earlier in the day by Bundesbank council members Edgar Meister and Hans-Juergen Krupp, who said the dollar's drop below 1.50 marks was not appropriate.
